## How to run it

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/LGAI-EXAONE/EXAONE-4.0-32B/blob/a1d54d1c148c30881ed27e035b650da489b51b92/README.md) · LG AI Research official model card: EXAONE 4.0 32B context length 131,072 tokens. Fact only; the card's model licence (non-commercial) governs weights, not this number. Observed 2026-09-25.

```sh
llama-server -hf LGAI-EXAONE/EXAONE-4.0-32B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
llama-server -hf LGAI-EXAONE/EXAONE-4.0-32B-GGUF:Q8_0
```
